result.question: Why did the Arameans think the king of Israel had hired the kings of the Hittites and Egyptians to attack them?

readings.answer: Because they heard the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army.
readings.support: to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army, so that they said to one another,

readings.answer: Because the Lord had caused them to hear those sounds.
readings.support: For the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army

assessments.reason: Verse 7:6 links their conclusion to hearing “the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army … so that they said,” making the heard sounds the immediate reason, even though the verse also attributes the cause of those sounds to the Lord.
This matches 7:6 exactly: “For the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army,” which explains why they thought Israel had hired other kings.
